title: applied-ml-experiment-scratchpad-2026-03-06-jordan
content:
2026-03-06 - daily scratchpad (Jordan)
Quick log / running notes for the applied ML experiments. Mostly messy - TODOs, results, commands, random observations.

Goals for today:
- finalize quantization comparison (int8 vs int4) for gpt-small-8k variant
- run eval set (convqa-1k) with prompt variants A/B/C and collect accuracy + perplexity
- try runtime flags: --kv-cache=on, --batch-size=4, --prefetch=2

TODO (short)
- [ ] add eval runner metrics to dashboard (grafana) -> INFR-2891
- [x] push small change to runtime for int4 fallback (PR #437) - merged
- [ ] schedule sync with infra (Samir) about GPU pool for Dedicated testing
- [ ] write up brief on prompt A vs prompt B for PM review (due Fri)

Experiment notes
----------------
Run set: quant-2026-03-06-1 (int8 baseline)
- model: gpt-small-8k (fp16 checkpoint)
- quant: q8_0 (per-channel symmetric)
- runtime: docker rti:latest, flags: --kv-cache on --batch-size 4
- command: ./eval_runner --model gpt-small-8k --quant q8_0 --prompts ./prompts/prompt-set-A.json --dataset ./data/convqa-1k.json --out out/q8_a.json
- quick results (pilot): accuracy 0.72, avg_latency 120ms/token, token-perf 3200 tps (single GPU)
- notes: stable, no output degradation vs fp16 on small subset (n=100).

Run set: quant-2026-03-06-2 (int4 aggressive)
- quant: q4_0 (per-tensor, symmetric) with GPT-optimized reorder
- command similar to above -> out/q4_a.json
- quick results: accuracy 0.69, avg_latency 95ms/token, token-perf 5200 tps
- notes: quality drop ~3 points vs int8 on conv QA. Failure cases concentrated on numeric answers and multi-step reasoning (see examples below). Some instability on longer contexts (6k+ tokens) leading to hallucination-like outputs.

Prompt sets (short)
- A (baseline): system: "You are an assistant. Answer concisely." user prompt: direct question + context block.
- B (chain-of-thought probe): same but add "Explain your reasoning step-by-step." (we do not require exposing chain in prod, this is eval)
- C (verbalize constraints): add "Always cite the sentence indices from the context."

Preliminary prompt results (convqa-1k subset)
- A (q8): acc 0.72
- B (q8): acc 0.74 (small lift, but much higher token cost and latency)
- A (q4): acc 0.69
- B (q4): acc 0.71
- C had many failures due to citation heuristics failing with quantized logits -> more brittle

Observations / hypotheses
- Int4 gives good throughput gains (~1.6x) but some systematic degradation for multi-step reasoning and numeric precision.
- Chain-of-thought style prompts partially recover quality under int4, probably because they encourage more distributed representations? need to test more.
- Runtime flags: enabling KV cache reduces latency significantly for repeated-prefix evals; but for long unique-context evals it adds slight overhead. Need a toggle in eval runner to auto-disable cache for unique-document workloads. (file: eval_runner/configs/cache-toggle.md)

Commands that were useful (local)
- run full eval: ./eval_runner --model gpt-small-8k --quant q8_0 --prompts ./prompts/prompt-set-A.json --dataset ./data/convqa-1k.json --batch 8 --out out/q8_full.json --no-stream
- profiling: python tools/profile_tokens.py out/q4_a.json --plot
- compare: python tools/compare_runs.py out/q8_a.json out/q4_a.json --metrics accuracy perplexity latency > analysis/q8_vs_q4.txt

Examples of failure cases (copy from run outputs)
- Q: "What year was the treaty signed?" (context contains dates 1789, 1791, 1803). q8-> 1791 correct; q4-> 1789 (off by context index).
- Q: multi-hop: requires summing two quantities across paragraphs -> q8 correct, q4 returns single-paragraph partial.

Next steps / experiments to schedule
- 1) Run larger evals (full convqa-1k) for both q8 and q4 with prompt B and C. Collect per-question diff and error categories. (priority: high)
- 2) Try q4 with per-channel calibration (we used per-tensor for q4_0). See if numeric errors reduce. (priority: medium)
- 3) Add synthetic numeric tests (arithmetic-type) to isolate rounding error. (priority: low)
- 4) Wire-up eval outputs into dashboard -> add metrics cards (accuracy, delta vs baseline, latency percentiles).

Open questions / unknowns
- Is the int4 degradation due more to quantization or to kernel recomputation/approx rounding in runtime? Need ablation toggling quant math vs kernel.
- Does retraining or FT with quant-aware loss recover the gap? Might be heavy cost - estimate cycles.

Notes to self
- follow up with Asha on config for dedicated GPU pool (she offered 2x A100 for a day Wed/Thu).
- remind Samir to open ephemeral quota for perf job (ticket INFR-2891).
- write up short summary for PM: 1 page with perf vs quality tradeoff and recommended default profile (q8 for accuracy-sensitive, q4 for latency/cost).

Attachments / files referenced locally
- ./prompts/prompt-set-A.json
- ./prompts/prompt-set-B.json
- ./data/convqa-1k.json
- out/q8_a.json, out/q4_a.json, analysis/q8_vs_q4.txt

Random notes (brain dump)
- consider adding micro-calibration step: run 100 representative tokens, compute bias correction per-layer before serving. Might reduce numeric drift.
- think about adding prompt-level fallback: detect low-confidence (entropy) in quantized run and fallback to int8 for that request. Could combine with smart routing.

End of scratchpad for 2026-03-06.
